; docformat = 'rst' ;+ ; Get WAVELNTH keyword from FITS header, taking WAVEUNIT into account. ; ; :Categories: ; ; SST pipeline ; ; ; :Author: ; ; Mats Löfdahl, Institute for Solar Physics ; ; ; :Returns: ; ; The wavelength in meters. ; ; :Params: ; ; ; ; ; ; ; :Keywords: ; ; ; ; ; ; ; :History: ; ; 2017-06-19 : MGL. First version. ; ; ; ; ;- pro red_fitspar_getwavelnth, hdr $ , wavelnth = wavelnth, haswav = haswav $ , waveunit = waveunit, hasunit = hasunit wavelnth = fxpar(hdr, 'WAVELNTH', count = haswav) waveunit = fxpar(hdr, 'WAVEUNIT', count = hasunit) if haswav and hasunit then wavelnth *= 10d^long(waveunit) end
